pashupatinath_temple.name: Pashupatinath Temple
pashupatinath_temple.description: A sacred Hindu temple complex dedicated to Lord Shiva, situated on the banks of the Bagmati River.

boudhanath_stupa.name: Boudhanath Stupa
boudhanath_stupa.description: One of the largest spherical stupas in Nepal, a UNESCO World Heritage site and major Buddhist pilgrimage site.

swayambhunath.name: Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple)
swayambhunath.description: An ancient religious complex atop a hill in the Kathmandu Valley, known for its iconic stupa and views of the city.
